자 같은 시기 활동 했던: Now, the ones who were active in the same period
안되는데 니느웨는 되는 거 봤죠? 황당한 하나님께서 마지막으로 아모스를: It doesn't work, but you saw it worked with Nineveh, right? So God, dumbfounded, finally tries sending Amos, and then tries sending Hosea.
2. 아모스 별명 – 정의의 선지자: 2. Amos's nickname – the prophet of justice
<암1:1> 유다 왕 웃시야의 시대 곧 이스라엘 왕 요아스의 아들 여로보:
<Amos 1:1> The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
 - Amos was a man from Judah in the south. Israel just wouldn't listen to the prophets, so God sent a southerner up to the north to see if that would at least get their attention. Notice the words "two years before the earthquake." Here's what it means: God sent Elijah, sent Elisha, and they still wouldn't listen, but when He sent Jonah to Nineveh, Nineveh listened.
‘야 이게 되는데 왜 너희들은 안 되냐’ 혹시나 해서 아모스를 보냈는데: ‘Hey, it works there, so why won't it work with you?’ He sent Amos just in case, and when even that didn't work, two years later came the earthquake. Maybe God got angry, and since He couldn't strike the people, He struck the ground instead. We do that too, right? We can't hit a person, so we kick the trash can or something...
According to Jewish tradition, it was such a big earthquake that a certain mountain was pushed about four kilometers away. The event from that time has come down in Israel's history as a saying. When people saw someone running off in a panic, they'd say, “Looks like he's running from the earthquake in Uzziah's day.” That's how big an earthquake it was, and
He judges the surrounding nations first. Look at verse 3.
<암1:3> 여호와께서 가라사대 다메섹의 서너 가지 죄로 인하여 내가 그: <Amos 1:3> Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
<암1:6> 여호와께서 가라사대 가사의 서너 가지 죄로 인하여 내가 그: <Amos 1:6> Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
<암1:9> 여호와께서 가라사대 두로의 서너 가지 죄로 인하여 내가 그: <Amos 1:9> Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
<암1:11> 여호와께서 가라사대 에돔의 서너 가지 죄로 인하여 내가 그: <Amos 1:11> Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
<암1:13> 여호와께서 가라사대 암몬 자손의 서너 가지 죄로 인하여 내: <Amos 1:13> Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
<암2:1> 여호와께서 가라사대 모압의 서너 가지 죄로 인하여 내가 그: <Amos 2:1> Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
<암2:4> 여호와께서 가라사대 유다의 서너 가지 죄로 인하여 내가 그: <Amos 2:4> Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of the LORD, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
여기까지 들은 이스라엘 신나서 휘파람을 불고 난리가 났겠죠? 그런데 지금: Hearing all this, Israel must have been thrilled, whistling and making a big fuss, right? But that was all just the warm-up. Now comes the main event: "for three transgressions of Israel..." and it goes on all the way to chapter 9. The whole thing lays bare Israel's sins, one by one.
① 부자들의 사치가 극에 달하였다\n ② 물질주의 향락주의에 빠져 있었다:
① The luxury of the rich had reached its peak
 ② They were sunk in materialism and pleasure-seeking
 ③ They sold the righteous for silver
 ④ A person was worth the price of a pair of shoes
 ⑤ The only yardstick for measuring everything was money
 ⑥ They dragged the Nazirites in and made them drink wine - Unbelievers get believers to drink and say, "See, you're just like us," and they seem to secretly enjoy it.
 ⑦ They shut the prophets' mouths and kept them from prophesying
 ⑧ The powerful built summer palaces and winter palaces
 ⑨ They built ivory palaces and lived in luxury and corruption
⑩ 여자들도 술을 퍼 마시고 놀아났다\n ⑪ 상아 침대에서 늦잠 자고 기:
⑩ The women too guzzled wine and ran wild
 ⑪ They slept in on ivory beds and stretched
 ⑫ They chattered idle songs to the sound of the viol
 ⑬ They scooped wine by the bowlful and drank it down
 ⑭ They sprinkled every kind of precious perfume on themselves
 ⑮ They bathed in milk
 ⑯ They turned judgment into gall
 ⑰ They made justice bitter like wormwood
 ⑱ They made the ephah big and the shekel small
 ⑲ They got rich on dishonest gain

<암5:21~24> 내가 너희 절기를 미워하여 멸시하며 너희 성회들을 기:
<Amos 5:21~24> I hate, I despise your feast days, and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies. Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts. Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols. But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.
 - There were grand religious acts and events, but that's not what God wants. What He wants is for morality, honesty, and faith to be restored.
지금부터 제가 읽어 내려 갈 때에 너희가 내게로 돌아오지 않았다는 말이: As I read this out now, underline it every time the words "yet have ye not returned unto me" come up. God tried this way and that way, every way, and Israel still did not return.
<암4:6~13> 또 내가 너희 모든 성읍에서 너희 이를 한가하게 하며: <Amos 4:6~13> And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
두 세 성읍 사람이 어떤 성읍으로 비틀거리며 물을 마시러 가서 만족히 마: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
내가 풍재와 깜부기 재앙으로 너희를 쳤으며 팟종이로 너희의 많은 동산과: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
내가 너희 중에 염병이 임하게 하기를 애굽에서 한 것처럼 하였으며 칼로: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
내가 너희 중의 성읍 무너뜨리기를 하나님 내가 소돔과 고모라를 무너뜨림같:
I have overthrown some of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
 - So no matter how much He spoke, they wouldn't listen, so God tried hitting them. Back in the time of the Judges, at least when they got hit they'd say it hurt and cry out to God, right? But by Amos's time, even when they got hit they just ground their teeth, and they did everything else but they would not return to God.
<암8:11> 주 여호와께서 가라사대 보라 날이 이를지라 내가 기근을 땅:
<Amos 8:11> Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of the LORD:
 - In the end, in the last days, a famine of not hearing the word will come. And not knowing that, they shut the prophets' mouths and tell them not to prophesy.
7. 인류의 종말에 회복에 관한 예언: 7. Prophecy about restoration at the end of humanity
<암9:14~15> 내가 내 백성 이스라엘의 사로잡힌 것을 돌이키리니 저: <Amos 9:14~15> And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them. And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.
회복의 말씀이죠. 지금 하나님께서 어떤 심정으로 이런 말씀을 하시는거예요: It's a word of restoration. With what kind of heart is God saying this? The almighty God is so angry because this tiny little nation, about the size of Korea's Gangwon Province, just won't do what He wants.
절기를 지키는 것, 성회로 모이는 것, 번제, 화목제, 찬양, 비파 소리: Keeping the feasts, gathering for solemn assemblies, burnt offerings, peace offerings, praise, the sound of the viol..... He's saying He can't stand the sight of any of it. Folks, what do you think He thinks looking at the Korean church today? No love for God at all: "Ugh, why does Sunday come around so often? Worship is such a pain. God, please just take the tithe and leave me alone. Stop bugging me to pray, serve, do missions, all that..." That's how it was in Amos's day too.
